author: ULTIMATE7FALCON
body:
Yes, I know that Vendetta was already released original post by Awesome_Apricot about a month ago. Since them it has undergone quite a few changes though both aesthetically and game-play wise.

The aesthetics were changed from the plain endstone look to a more pleasing netherbrick and granite/diorite style.

Here's a list of most of the game-play changes: the amount of blocks in the spawn kit were decreased, the chest plates in the wool pod were given projectile protection 1, the straight to the wool pod was changed to a hill and made much shorter then before, the premade defenses were edited accordingly, the 3 outermost islands were moved higher, the build height was increased, an arrow spawner was added on the outermost center island, the gear in the spawn chests were edited including the removal of buckets, and a place to actually cap the wool was added.
